title: Paint where you want movement

body.text: lets you 'paint' the area of the image you want to move, then set its direction — e.g. paint a waterfall and have it flow down. Unpainted areas stay still, giving you very fine control over movement.

example: Paint the flag and set it to wave to the right, while the flagpole and sky stay still

title: Combine with camera directions

body.text: Use Motion Brush to control objects + camera directions to control the whole frame at the same time — e.g. paint waves rolling in, then direct the camera to slowly zoom in, for a clip with depth and clear direction.

example: Motion Brush: ocean waves rolling to shore + Camera: slow zoom in + sunset light
